notes.title: Bride for the Princess Full Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Our latest Visual Novel has left Early Access and is now a full release![/h1]

It'll have a special launch discount of -15% off the full price. We hope that you'll enjoy playing it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

[h2]We also have released Digital Artbook[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860

You may also get them together on a Special Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16263

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34694528/7c46d5171e9d5f94de5a49da09900255f148307f.png[/img]

[b]Dialogue[/b]

[list][*]The door to the Snowtail Caverns now says it's locked instead of unable to open it[/list]

[b]Loot[/b]

[list][*]Enemies in Snowtail Caverns now drop Health Brews instead of Moonlight Flowers[/list]

[b]Lightning[/b]

[list][*]Some lightning effects were causing graphic glitches, they have been removed[/list]

[b]NPCs[/b]

[list][*]Added more NPC pets to towns[/list]

[b]Quest[/b]

[list][*]Brawnyne now straight up tells you where you need to go at the start game[/list]
